headlines.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO after Trump pushes board
headlines.description: Jensen Huang will return as Nvidia’s president and CEO, the company’s board announced Monday, in a stunning reversal after he resigned two weeks ago.

headlines.title: S&P 500 and Nasdaq surge after Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
headlines.description: Major U.S. stock indexes soared Monday, as Wall Street cheered Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia, sending the S&P 500 higher by as much as 5.6% and the Nasdaq 100 soaring by as much as 7.9%.

headlines.title: Congress reacts with anger and skepticism about Jensen Huang reinstatement
headlines.description: The stock market was thrilled with the announcement that Jensen Huang was returning as CEO of Nvidia, but lawmakers on both sides of the aisle reacted with shock — and said they still expect him to answer questions next week on Capitol Hill.

headlines.title: Trump says he spoke ‘directly and indirectly’ with Nvidia’s board about reinstating Jensen Huang
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said he spoke with Nvidia’s board members about reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO, telling CNBC on Monday morning that he sought to provide assurances to address their concerns about national security.

headlines.title: Storms expected on both coasts, threatening Thanksgiving travel
headlines.description: Strong storms, serious flooding and powerful winds could dampen Thanksgiving travel plans and celebrations in parts of the Northeast and California, forecasters said.

headlines.title: Nvidia Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
headlines.description: AI giant Nvidia has announced that Jensen Huang has been reinstated as president and CEO, just 11 days after he stepped down amid a series of scandals, including one where he held an extramarital relationship with an alleged Chinese spy.

headlines.title: How to Protect Yourself From Holiday Shopping Scams Online
headlines.description: A new report finds a massive spikes in scams this year with fake web sites offering “too good to be true” deals on popular brands and hot toys. NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY to help spot scams and protect your personal information.

headlines.title: Anthropic stock is down during its second day of trading after a historic Wall Street debut
headlines.description: After Anthropic's historic Wall Street debut, its stock is down during its second day of trading. NBC News' Brian Cheung and editor-in-chief at Investopedia, Caleb Silver, break down the latest details of the decline and what's at stake.

headlines.title: How to Get the Most Out of Early Black Friday Deals
headlines.description: Black Friday is one week away but many stores are already rolling out major savings. NBC’s Brian Cheung joins TODAY with what to buy now, what’s worth waiting on, and how to find the lowest prices.

headlines.title: How grocery prices have changed since Trump took office
headlines.description: Learn where grocery prices stand during the Trump administration. See how inflation is affecting the cost of eggs, bread, chicken, ground beef and more.

headlines.title: Democrats won on affordability. Whether they can deliver it is a different story.
headlines.description: Fulfilling a campaign promise to bring down high prices is a lot harder than it sounds. Just ask Donald Trump.

headlines.title: Delta restores system after nationwide flight delays as Thanksgiving travel begins
headlines.description: Delta Air Lines said it restored an automated system Sunday afternoon after a problem with it delayed flights nationwide as Thanksgiving travel got underway.
